title: Crochet Butterfly Charm
name: Butterfly Charm
description: Free crochet butterfly charm pattern: a dc circle, a round of shells and a picot scallop edge. Quick, pretty and printable. Free PDF, step by step.
lead: A lacy round charm in three rounds: a dc circle, a round of eight shells and a picot scallop on every shell.
notes: Picot: ch 3, then sl st into the first of those chains.

rounds.text: Magic ring, ch 3, 16 dc in the ring, sl st.
ch 3, (2 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in the same st, then (3 dc, ch 2, 3 dc) in every 2nd st x7, sl st.
sc, (5 dc, ch 3 picot, 5 dc) in the ch-2 space, sc in the next st between shells. Repeat around. Fasten off.
